content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Boston

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and years managing projects. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can verify your qualifications before you enroll in the 35-hour course.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training. Attend all sessions synchronously with active certified practitioners teaching the PMBOK Guide framework, real-world scenarios, and exam strategy. Earn your official 35 contact hours—the PMI-mandated education requirement—on a schedule that fits your Boston-area work calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience credentials. Pay the PMI examination fee and receive official authorization to sit for the PMP exam within your eligibility window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE test center and complete the computer-based assessment. Results are available immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential renews every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or publishing project-management work. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PMP renewal courses and professional development to keep your certification current and marketable.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
